T: One guitar case. Wrong guitar case.
D: A travelling musician is mistaken for a hitman in a Mexican border town.
P: Serve the mains when the mariachi walks into the bar looking for work.
S: Slow-roasted chilli pork crisped in a pan, with pineapple, onion and coriander
Pork shoulder marinated in chilli, orange and pineapple, roasted, sliced and crisped, in small corn tortillas with pineapple, onion and coriander.
Cantina garlic and chilli fried peanuts
the bar where he asks to play

Raw peanuts fried with whole garlic cloves and dried chillies until golden, tossed hot with lime and salt, served by the bowl on the bar. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wide pan over medium heat. Add 400g raw peanuts and 8 peeled garlic cloves and stir for 6 minutes until golden. Add 6 dried red chillies broken in half and cook 1 more minute. Tip into a bowl, squeeze over a lime and toss with 1 tsp salt and a pinch of chilli powder. Cool for 10 minutes so they crisp up before serving.
Smashed avocado with charred jalapeño, lime, onion and coriander

Ripe avocado smashed rough with charred jalapeño, white onion, lime and coriander, finished with crumbled feta and served with warm salted corn chips. Char 2 jalapenos in a dry pan until blackened, then seed and chop fine. Halve 3 ripe avocados and smash roughly with a fork. Stir in the jalapeno, the juice of 2 limes, half a finely diced white onion and a handful of chopped coriander. Season well with salt and top with 50g crumbled feta. Warm the corn chips at 180C for 4 minutes and serve straight away.
M: Lime and cumin marinated skirt steak, sliced thin, with rice and black beans

Skirt steak marinated 2 hours in lime, garlic, cumin and orange, seared over very high heat, rested and sliced thin against the grain, with rice, black beans and charred spring onions. Marinate 800g skirt steak for 2 hours in lime juice, garlic, ground cumin and a little orange juice. Sear over very high heat for 3 minutes a side, rest and slice thin against the grain. Serve with long grain rice, warmed black beans and charred spring onions.
the hotel where he hides out

Corn tortillas rolled around shredded chicken and cheese, covered in a red chilli and tomato sauce and more cheese, baked bubbling and finished with crema and coriander. Poach 600g chicken thighs in salted water for 20 minutes, then shred. Soak 3 dried chillies in hot water, then blitz with a 400g can of tomatoes, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin and salt, and simmer 10 minutes. Dip 8 corn tortillas in the sauce, fill with chicken and 150g grated cheddar, roll and pack into a dish. Pour over the rest of the sauce, top with 100g more cheese and bake at 190C for 20 minutes. Finish with sour cream and coriander.
W: Baked coconut and condensed milk mounds, golden at the edges

Chewy golden Mexican coconut sweets baked from fresh coconut, sugar and condensed milk, piled on a plate beside a battered guitar case. Mix 250g desiccated coconut, 395g condensed milk, 2 egg yolks and 1 tsp vanilla. Spoon 20 small mounds onto a lined tray and bake at 170C for 18 minutes until golden on the edges. Cool on the tray until firm.
K: Mexican lager over lime, tomato juice, hot sauce and Worcestershire, chilli salt rim

Ice-cold Mexican lager poured over lime juice, tomato juice, hot sauce and Worcestershire in a glass rimmed with chilli salt, finished with a lime wedge. Mix 2 tbsp salt with 1 tsp chilli powder on a plate. Run a lime wedge around four tall glasses and dip the rims in the chilli salt. Fill with ice. Into each glass add 30ml lime juice, 60ml tomato juice, 4 dashes hot sauce and 2 dashes Worcestershire sauce. Top each with a cold 355ml bottle of Mexican lager, stir once and garnish with a lime wedge.
